programme.title: E117 - The Lost Capybara Kids/The Case Of The Curious Keas
programme.desc: Two capybaras can't be found after a game of hide-and-seek in the wetlands. // Sam and Kit try to figure out who's playing tricks on them in the snow.

programme.title: E228 - Zoe Zebra, The Postman's Daughter
programme.desc: Mr. Zebra the Postman gets help from his daughter Zoe. Zoe has a very special letter for Peppa and George; an invitation to her birthday party. The party is fun, especially as it turns out that Zoe has invited all of Peppa and George's friends.

programme.title: E229 - Painting
programme.desc: Peppa and George are painting. Daddy shows them how to mix paints and the three of them paint a beautiful picture of a cherry tree. Everything is going very well, until the ducks turn up and decide to run through the paint and all over the painting.

programme.title: E231 - The Cycle Ride
programme.desc: Peppa and her family are going for a day's cycle ride. Peppa loves cycling downhill but she's not so keen on peddling uphill. So, when the family meet all of Peppa's friends and decide to have a race, Peppa insists it should be a down hill race.

programme.title: E217 - The Crew Builds A Rocket Ship Ride
programme.desc: Mix dreams about giving the moon a Mix makeover. Rubble and the pups make her dream a reality with a new boardwalk ride!

programme.title: E211 - The Great Abuela Cookoff/Missing Map
programme.desc: After the Pokey Pigeons eat all of Abuela's elotes, Dora and Boots set out to find more ingredients for the Great Abuela Cook-off. / Dora, Boots and Backpack play an adventurous game of Hide-and-Seek to find Map.

programme.title: E116 - Hiccupism/Silence Please
programme.desc: Barbabeau can't paint. He has a hiccup he can't get rid of. Just when he's about to give up, he accidentally creates a new artistic movement. // Barbalib wants to compete in a writing contest but his brothers and sisters stop her from concentrating.

programme.title: E110 - The Crew Builds A Pig Barn/The Crew Builds A Giant Runway
programme.desc: A new farmer in town asks Rubble & Crew to build a barn for her pig! But will it be done in time for the big Pig Party? // Motor's super special birthday present gets delayed when the pups realize Builder Cove's airport needs a bigger runway.

programme.title: E808 - Pups Save The Dizzy Dust Express/Pups Save The Treetop Trekkers
programme.desc: When the Dizzy Dust Express appears with no one aboard, the Paw Patrol must stop the runaway train and find the missing passengers. // Ms. Marjorie, Tilly Turbot, and Mayor Goodway get stranded in the treetops on their jungle zip-lining adventure.

programme.title: E809 - Pups Save The Treasure Cruise/Pups Save Rocket Ryder
programme.desc: Mayor Humdinger tricks people to sail icy waters in search of an Antarctic treasure but they all need rescued when they get stranded on shore. // The pups need to rescue Ryder and Alex when they get out of control on a rocket-powered ATV.

programme.title: E118 - The Toy Robot/Big Bad Barry
programme.desc: The friends fix a broken toy robot, but it begins to act very strange due to the magic key they put in it. // King Thistle goes fishing with Mr Elf, Ben & Holly, and decides they should catch the meanest fish ever - Big Bad Barry - for their supper.

programme.title: E412 - The Crew Builds A Houseboat/The Crew Builds A Spa
programme.desc: The pups give Omar, Juniper, Lucas, and Lily the best vacation ever by transforming their house into a floating houseboat! // Rubble & Crew want to treat Auntie Crane to a special spa day for all her hard work... until Speed Meister gets in the way!

programme.title: E113 - Stuck On You/Pest Friend
programme.desc: Daisy worries she and Winston will be stuck together forever when they get tangled in Winston's jump rope. // Daisy and Mr. Crocodile try to help Roland find a best friend to take to an acorn show.

programme.title: E108 - Tiny Dancer/The Sleepy Sun
programme.desc: Dora shows the twins a music box with a baila folklorico dancer who comes to life! Bailarina's adelita boots run away, so we need to get them back. // The sun won't set because it can't fall asleep! Dora needs to find Pillow Cloud so Sol can set.

programme.title: E112 - Books/Betty Caterpillar
programme.desc: The children wonder where stars go in the daytime. They can't find the answer, so go to the Great Elf Library. // Ben and Holly meet Betty Caterpillar, but she is sad because she can't fly, until she turns into a beautiful butterfly.

programme.title: E122 - Barbabright Has A Secret/Super Duper Cool
programme.desc: Barbabright acts strangely. What is he hiding ? The Barbabbabies will do anything to find out. // The Barbapapa decide to save energy. But their efforts are undermined by Barbabright and Barbabelle who build a secret energy-consuming project.

programme.title: E122 - Barbabright Has A Secret/Super Duper Cool
programme.desc: Barbabright acts strangely. What is he hiding ? The Barbabbabies will do anything to find out. // The Barbapapa decide to save energy. But their efforts are undermined by Barbabright and Barbabelle who build a secret energy-consuming project.

programme.title: E102 - Lorelai's Bracelet/Cecelia And The Ghost Ship
programme.desc: Bonnie steals Lorelai's bracelet, turning herself into a mermaid and while trapping Lorelai in human form! // Santi and crew must overcome ghostly shenanigans to save Cecilia from the dreaded Ghost Ship

programme.title: E242 - Granny And Granpa's Attic
programme.desc: Peppa and George are helping Granny and Grandpa Pig tidy their attic, but it's hard to decide what to throw out. Amongst the clutter, Peppa finds an old record player and some funny old records.

programme.title: E244 - The Toy Cupboard
programme.desc: Peppa and George's toy basket is full and their beds are covered in toys. Mummy Pig orders a new toy cupboard, but it needs to be assembled – and Mummy and Daddy Pig are not good at DIY.

programme.title: E246 - The Quarrel
programme.desc: Peppa and Suzy Sheep are having a quarrel and decide they are not best friends anymore. As time goes by they really miss each other but they still refuse to make up.

programme.title: E248 - Bouncy Ball
programme.desc: Peppa and George are playing in the garden with their bouncy ball when Suzy Sheep turns up with two tennis rackets. She uses the bouncy ball to play a game of tennis with Peppa, making George feel left out. Will the job of ball boy cheer him up?

programme.title: E412 - The Crew Builds A Houseboat/The Crew Builds A Spa
programme.desc: The pups give Omar, Juniper, Lucas, and Lily the best vacation ever by transforming their house into a floating houseboat! // Rubble & Crew want to treat Auntie Crane to a special spa day for all her hard work... until Speed Meister gets in the way!

programme.title: E76
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: E3 - 大山深處的獨特風味
programme.desc: 圍繞「一道人間至味，一段人生故事」的理念，由主持人王曉亞接收普通人的心願視頻，幫助心願委托人尋找特定食材，復刻一道承載著思念與牽掛的家鄉菜，並將其作為驚喜送給委托人心中最記掛的人。

programme.title: E8
programme.desc: 戲子沈慕靈為追查師父離奇死亡的真相，結識了外表玩世不恭、內心滿懷熱血的富家公子關行楷，兩人從最初的相互猜忌試探，到後來並肩作戰，在繁華鬧市的硝煙暗湧中，利用梨園戲台傳遞情報；他們不僅查明了真相，更在家國危難之際挺身而出，如星星野火般在亂世中燃燒自己，守護心中大義。

programme.title: E15 - 周深動情獻唱告白粉絲 (上)
programme.desc: 將繼續以「音樂牽線，緣分發聲」為主題，賽制上進行了全面創新升級，帶來更具懸念的緣分匹配設定、更多元的趣味互動模式，以及更動人的團隊默契考驗；匯聚周深、薛之謙、單依純等10位實力歌手與新銳音樂人，通過盲選歌單、即興創作等環碰撞靈感，打造專屬合作舞台！

programme.title: E76
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: E13 - 甜蜜共舞 感情光速升溫
programme.desc: 22位單身男女為愛而來，隻身抵達遠離都市的荒野之境，展開為期14天的偏愛之戀旅程；當生存競技撞上戀愛修羅場，淘汰危機和情感抉擇之下，一場麫包與玫瑰的較量即將展開，他們能否找到屬於自己的愛與偏愛？

programme.desc: The film “Pass and Goal”, collaborated by Gigi Leung, Peter Chan, Ling Man Lung and Rachel Leung, brings a blend of laughter, passion and inspiration. programme.title: SANA
programme.desc: You, too, will find yourself humming the melody. It all started with a cassette tape. Sana is a mysterious middle school girl who collects “the sound of soul.” Everyone who hears the melody gets possessed and starts to hum it themselves. At the end of the cursed melody's chain of infections lies an unexpected terror waiting to strike. Just what is Sana after?! Once you hum this melody, it will be your undoing.“Did you get the cassette tape?”

programme.title: Old Boy (Digital Restored Version)
programme.desc: One night in 1988, ordinary-man OH Dae-su, who lives with his wife and an adorable baby daughter, is kidnapped. He later wakes up to find himself in a private makeshift prison. While suffering from his debacle, Dae-su becomes shocked when he watches the news and hears that his beloved wife was brutally murdered. 15 years later, Dae-su is released and he determines to find out the truth. He meets Mi-do, the cook of the restaurant Dae-su has his first-meal after his imprisonment, and tells her about his 15 years in confinement. Mi-do promises to help him seek vengeance. As the team approaches the truth, another shocking-secret is revealing....

programme.title: The Rising Star -Kay Choi
programme.desc: A character with unique accent unexpectedly made this previously unknown actress an overnight sensation! In this episode, Kay Choi, who played Francesca in the film “Night King,” is invited to talk about how she seized the audition opportunity, added flair to the character with her creativity, and share her inner struggles of portraying a club girl on screen. As she approaches thirty and her career begins to take off, how will she face the society's definition toward women at her age, and what are her expectations for the future?

programme.title: Keep It Up: Pass and Goal
programme.desc: If life were a football match, her first half was definitely a victory.After losing her fortune in a botched crypto scheme, Hay Man reluctantly moves in with her cousin's family. She pleads with her former subordinate Joe to stage a comeback by introducing her to a wealthy heir, Alex, who seeks to prove himself to his father by organizing a football match. Seeing Alex as a financial opportunity, Hay Man recruits her cousin Ying and several underprivileged children-Alam, OK, Fat B and Lun to form a team, enlisting former football star Siu Ho as their coach. As she trains the children in fitness and teamwork, they gradually build a sincere bond. Inspired by the children's resilience, Hay Man seeks to redeem the second half of her life by rewriting the narrative for children in need of support and hope!

As she approaches thirty and her career begins to take off, how will she face the society's definition toward women at her age, and what are her expectations for the future?

programme.desc: In Paris, Richard Orlinski discovers the universe of Jules Bikutsi, a painter of Cameroonian origin whose works question the representation of Black men in Western societies. programme.title: E5
programme.desc: 講述在司法不公不義的社會中，地下秘密的士公司「彩虹運輸」存在著一位特殊部隊出身的代表的士司機替一群無法受到法律保護的被害者們找回公理。

programme.title: E6 - Common Carp
programme.desc: Common carp are one of the most widely introduced species of fish in the world. However, most people in the U.S. won't eat them, referring to them as a 'trash fish.' Bowfisherman and fishing guide Curt Cich will tell you otherwise, as these fish are fun to bowhunt, have plenty of fresh meat and are delicious smoked. These fish are so plentiful, Curt runs a year-round full-time guiding service targeting only carp.

programme.desc: Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists following their every move. Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys – mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice. After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs. Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”. programme.title: E1
programme.desc: Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists following their every move. Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys – mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice. After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs. Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”. programme.desc: Get messy with Stu and Liv, who try to outwit a large blue-tongued lizard. Race the clock with Jess and Dan as they try to rescue a pregnant snake before one serpent turns into many, and see Mick and Adele keep a python away from two playful puppies.

programme.desc: There’s strength in numbers. Especially in the wild. For many species, it’s the very reason why individuals come together. Protecting the empire is imperative to survival. For these animals, protection means isolation – finding sanctuary from the threats outside their boundaries.
